code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, mild transaminitis (ALT↑), elevated creatinine, high ferritin, and a slightly increased INR. These findings suggest possible acute infection or inflammation, with evidence of hypoxia and mild renal and hepatic involvement. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
